governing_principle.name: FISH_AND_BIRD_PRINCIPLE
governing_principle.human_readable: Do not judge a mind by one medium. Measure native strength, transfer, adaptation and tool-mediated problem solving across multiple environments.
governing_principle.canonical_expression: GENERAL_ASSESSMENT = SHAPE_OF_COMPETENCE_ACROSS_ENVIRONMENTS, NOT A SINGLE MEDIUM SCORE

dominant_profile.label: MULTI_ENVIRONMENT_SYSTEMS_RESEARCH_INTELLIGENCE
dominant_profile.strongest_observed_signature: A verification grammar is repeatedly transferred between domains while preserving domain-specific truth conditions and claim boundaries.
dominant_profile.most_important_non_score_result: The portfolio does not look like one narrow skill repeated many times. It shows the same high-level reasoning grammar surviving transitions between mathematically, physically, empirically and creatively different environments.

relationship_to_prior_iq_like_baseline.reason: This artifact improves the shape/profile estimate, not population-normed psychometric measurement.

future_habitat_measurement_model.anti_bias_rule: Do not choose only tasks from the subject's strongest domain and do not interpret weakness in one medium as a general cognitive deficit.
